request.title: CATACLYSM · BoRHeZ Games
request.prompt:
Apply evidence-grounded feedback from the recorded gameplay review. Preserve unrelated working behavior, controls and the stable URL.
Update Cataclysm survival playtest to improve player progression satisfaction and gameplay variety by restoring a life gain or health recovery mechanic on level-up, introducing additional enemy types and unique enemy behaviors, expanding upgrade options to include special abilities at milestone levels (e.g., multi-shot, bouncing bullets, cat-specific skills), and enhancing fish collectible feedback with visual or audio indicators and a lingering pickup animation. Additionally, ensure upgrade menu interaction fully prevents player damage or control loss during selection.
acceptance: Player receives an extra life or health restoration option at certain level-up milestones, increasing the maximum lives from 3 to a higher cap (proposed up to 9) in gameplay tests.
New enemy variants become present by level 3 and above, displaying distinct appearances and behaviors (e.g., different movement patterns or attack styles).

Special upgrade options (such as multi-shot, bouncing bullets, or unique cat abilities) are available specifically at milestone levels like 3, 6, and 9, in addition to the basic damage, firing rate, and speed upgrades.
When fish collectibles are picked up, a visible animation or effect persists briefly post-collection, accompanied by a sound cue, enhancing player feedback without instantly disappearing.

During upgrade selection screens, time and combat remain fully frozen, and players cannot take damage or lose control even if enemies spawn nearby or inputs lag, verified by testing damage immunity and input responsiveness.
No regression occurs in existing mechanics: auto-firing cat, HUD clarity, control responsiveness, and upgrade menu functionality remain smooth and bug-free after changes.
Gameplay difficulty scales smoothly with new enemies and upgrades, maintaining challenge without being unfairly punishing due to lack of life gain.
UI clearly indicates when special upgrade options appear at milestones, with well-labeled buttons and descriptions understandable on mobile devices.

producer.claim: Implement the requested Cataclysm update to restore a health gain mechanic on level-up, add new enemy types and behaviors, special milestone-level upgrades, enhanced fish collectible feedback, and ensure upgrade menu disables damage and input loss during selection, without disrupting existing mechanics or controls.
producer.rationale: The source code provided is the Cataclysm game with a stable mobile-first Canvas implementation, existing upgrade mechanic with 3 upgrade options, automatic firing, fish collectibles, health UI, HUD, enemies, and input handling via pointer and keyboard. The game currently supports level progression and upgrade selection with simulation freeze. The gameplay loop and rendering accommodate enemies and pickups, while health and player stats are displayed. There is logic for spawning enemies, projectiles, fish pickups with animation, and player damage with invincibility frames. The upgrade menu is modal and freezes gameplay time and combat. The current implementation allows for adding features like health restoration on level-up, new enemy variants after level 3 with distinct AI behavior, special milestone upgrade options, enhanced feedback for fish pickups (animation and sound persistence), and blocking damage & control loss during upgrade menu interaction.
producer.objections: Current code and evidence lack explicit presence of milestone-level special upgrade options beyond base upgrades, no explicit implementation of new enemy types or behaviors distinct from the current enemy spawn logic, health gain on level-up is absent (maxHp and hp fixed), and fish pickup animation & audio feedback beyond a basic particle burst is not clearly enhanced. The upgrade menu freezing currently might not explicitly guarantee zero damage or control loss from latency or enemy spawn events. Also, exact UI labeling for milestone upgrades and mobile UI clarity are not detailed. No demonstration of smooth difficulty scaling with new enemies or upgrade variety. Existing controls, auto-fire, HUD, and upgrade menu flow seem stable. No evidence of regressions but the incremental additions are unverified and need controlled implementation.

proposed_action.scope: Deliver a micro-update within Cataclysm preserving existing gameplay and controls that includes: (1) At certain level-up milestones (levels 3, 6, 9), offer three selectable upgrades including a health restoration or extra life option that increases maxHp up to 9; (2) Introduce at least one new enemy variant at level 3+ with different speed, size, and attack pattern to diversify gameplay; (3) Extend upgrade menu to present special milestone upgrade options (multi-shot, bouncing bullets, cat-specific skills) alongside basic upgrades, with clear UI labeling; (4) Enhance fish collectible pickups with lingering visual animation and accompanying audio cues to improve feedback; (5) Ensure upgrade selection interaction fully freezes time, disables damage, and prevents loss of player control even if enemies spawn or inputs lag; (6) Verify no regressions in existing controls, automatic firing, HUD elements, and upgrade menu functionality.
proposed_action.playable_result: A playable version where the player can successfully level from 1 to at least 9, receiving health restoration plus other unique upgrades explicitly at milestones, facing newly spawned unique enemy types starting at level 3, and seeing improved fish pick-up effects. During upgrade menu selection, the game freezes and is damage-proof. The player can survive by dodging enemies and collecting fish with visible feedback, confirming the additions.
completion_criteria: Player health can increase at milestone level-ups, maxHp raised up to 9 with confirmed HP restoration.
New enemy variants appear from level 3 onwards with distinct appearance and behaviors, verified visually and in gameplay logs.
Upgrade menus at milestone levels include special abilities in addition to base upgrades, with labeled buttons and descriptions visible on mobile.
Fish collectibles trigger visible and audio feedback that lingers briefly after pickup before removal.
During upgrade selection screens, time and combat fully freeze; player damage, knockback, or loss of control does not occur even if enemies spawn or input is delayed.
No disruptions or regressions to auto-fire, HUD health display, controls, or upgrade menu smoothness after implementation.
Gameplay difficulty scales smoothly without spike in unfairness due to added enemies or health mechanics.

required_evidence: Gameplay recording demonstrating level-ups with health restoration and milestone special upgrades appearing and selectable.
Logs or observables showing presence and behavior of at least one new enemy type with distinct movement or attack from level 3 onwards.
UI screenshots or accessibility audits validating clear labeling and description of special upgrade options on mobile device viewports.
Visual and audio capture confirming enhanced feedback on fish pickup with lingering animation and sound cue.
Gameplay testing logs confirming upgrade selection screens freeze time and combat fully with player damage immunity and no input blockage during selection.
Regression test results showing all existing mechanics function smoothly after changes, including auto-fire, pause/resume/restart flows, and HUD updates.
Balance metrics showing difficulty scales smoothly with the additions, not causing unfair or trivial gameplay.

researcher.claim: The Cataclysm update should preserve existing core gameplay mechanics, controls, HUD, and upgrade menu functionality; enhance player progression with health restoration on milestone level-ups; introduce new enemy variants with unique behaviors from level 3 onward; expand upgrade selections at milestones with special abilities; visually and audibly enhance fish collectible feedback; and fully freeze gameplay (precluding damage and input loss) during upgrade menu interaction.
researcher.rationale: The current implementation includes a stable Canvas-based mobile-first survival game with automatic firing, fish collectibles, upgrades on level-up freezing the game, health and score HUD, pointer and keyboard controls, difficulty scaling, pause/resume/restart functionality, and a modular upgrade menu offering three basic upgrades. However, the code lacks explicit evidence of health restoration or maxHp gain on level-ups, unique enemy variants beyond variations in current enemy size/speed, special milestone-specific upgrades beyond the base three, lingering visual/audio feedback for fish pickups, and guaranteed player invulnerability and control lockout during upgrade screen beyond general simulation freeze. The upgrade menu disables game running state and input clearing on activation, but does not explicitly handle damage or control loss immunity against enemy spawn or input latency. The source and prior job descriptions emphasize preserving and building atop existing mechanics without regressions, ensuring mobile UI clarity and stable URL, and maintaining friendly touch input. Hence, required new features must be carefully layered to avoid disrupting the stable baseline.
researcher.objections: No direct evidence in the supplied source or prior job completion confirms the full implementation of: (1) maxHp and current HP increase on level-up milestones; (2) introduction of new enemy types with distinct AI or attack styles from level 3 onward; (3) upgraded milestone upgrade menus including special abilities such as multi-shot or bouncing bullets with labeled UI; (4) fish pickup feedback with lingering animations and sound effects rather than instantaneous disappearances; (5) flawless freezing of time and combat during upgrade selection ensuring no damage or loss of control cases even under enemy spawn/input delays; and (6) UI label clarity for milestone upgrades on mobile. The existing enemy spawn logic uses uniform speed/hp formulas but does not define variant behaviors. The upgrade menu offers only base upgrades with no special abilities presented. Fish collectibles trigger sound and visual bursts, but no persistent animations. Player damage only partially reduced by invincibility frames not guaranteed disabled during upgrade screen. Therefore, additions must be implemented to augment the existing framework explicitly, otherwise these requirements remain unmet.
researcher.proposed_action: Implement a micro-update preserving existing game state and controls that: (1) modifies the player leveling logic to increase maximum and current HP (capped at 9) at specified milestone levels (3, 6, 9); (2) extends the enemy spawn method to produce at least one new enemy variant with unique speed, size, or simple behavior differences starting from level 3; (3) enhances the upgrade overlay UI to show special milestone upgrade buttons (including multi-shot, bouncing bullets, cat-specific abilities) alongside base upgrades with descriptive labels and accessible on mobile; (4) augments fish pick-up logic with visible lingering animations and an audio cue persisting briefly after acquisition; (5) explicitly disables enemy damage and player control loss during upgrade selection, guaranteeing invulnerability even if enemies spawn or inputs are delayed; (6) carefully test to confirm no regressions in auto fire, HUD, controls, and upgrade menu flows, preserving smooth pause/resume functionality and stable URL; and (7) add clear UI indications when milestone upgrades appear, ensuring accessibility on mobile devices without compromising the current user experience.
required_evidence: Gameplay recordings or logs demonstrating player HP and max HP increase on milestones 3, 6, and 9 with health restoration visibly applied.
Observable spawn and behavior of at least one uniquely moving or attacking enemy variant starting at player level 3+, documented in logs or videos.
Screenshots and accessibility tests confirming milestone upgrade menu shows special upgrade options with clear textual labels and descriptions on mobile screen sizes.
Video or snapshot evidence showing fish collectible pick-up triggers a visible animation or effect that lingers briefly and an audio cue that does not instantly cease.

Gameplay testing logs and recordings verifying the upgrade menu selection fully freezes time and combat, with no player damage or loss of movement/control possible during selection, even with enemy spawn or input latency.

Regression test results validating all existing gameplay mechanics including auto-firing, HUD displays, controls, pause/resume/restart, and upgrade menu behavior remain intact and smooth after the additions.
Balance data or QA reports showing the difficulty scale blends the new enemies and upgrades without causing unfair difficulty spikes or negating challenge.

designer.claim: The core gameplay loop involves one-finger drag input to move the cat avatar through a city arena, automatically firing at the nearest enemies, collecting fish pickups to gain experience points that lead to level-ups. On reaching milestone levels (3, 6, 9), the player receives a freeze in time and combat, a modal UI offering three distinct upgrade choices including a health restoration option raising max HP (up to 9), and special abilities such as multi-shot or bouncing bullets. Enemies spawn continuously with increasing difficulty and new enemy variants appear from level 3 with distinct size, speed, and movement behaviors. Fish pickups trigger enhanced feedback with lingering animations and sound cues. During upgrade selection, the game guarantees full freeze of all hostile interactions and input control lockout to prevent player damage or knocback, even if input lags or enemies spawn.
designer.rationale: The existing game code and interface provide a responsive Canvas-based mobile-first survival experience with pointer dragging controlling movement and automatic firing. The upgrade system already freezes the simulation and offers three base upgrades at level-up. To enrich player progression satisfaction and gameplay variety, the update proposes milestone-level health restoration and max HP increase capped at 9, new enemy variants with different behaviors from level 3, and expanded upgrade options including special abilities clearly indicated in the UI with accessible mobile-compatible buttons and descriptions. Enhanced fish pickups employ persistent visual effects and audio cues for satisfying feedback. The upgrade menu interaction explicitly disables player damage and input loss by freezing simulation time and clearing inputs, mitigating latency or spawn-related edge cases. This respects the standard game contract's requirements for one-finger friendly controls, clear HUD feedback, and smooth pause/resume flow.
designer.objections: The source code does not yet show implemented logic for increasing max HP and restoring health at milestone level-ups. There is no explicit differentiation of enemy logic or properties evidencing new unique enemy types beyond numeric config variations. The upgrade selection UI lacks distinct special milestone upgrades with labeled multi-shot or bouncing bullet abilities. Fish pickup animation and audio feedback remain transient particle bursts without lingering effects. Though gameplay freezes during upgrade menus, it is unclear if damage immunity and input lockout are fully guaranteed under enemy spawn or input lag. Furthermore, the clarity and accessibility of milestone upgrade options on mobile interfaces are not demonstrated. These unimplemented features pose uncertainty about completion completeness and may affect final player experience quality.
designer.proposed_action: Implement precise milestone detection to increase player's maxHp by 1 (max 9) and simultaneously restore current health on levels 3, 6, and 9. Modify enemy spawn logic to introduce a secondary enemy variant with distinct size, speed, and movement pattern starting at player level 3+. Extend upgrade overlay UI to append milestone-specific, clearly labeled special abilities such as multi-shot and bouncing bullets alongside base upgrades, ensuring the UI is accessible on mobiles. Enhance fish pickup logic to trigger a visible lingering animation and looping (then fading) audio cue independent of immediate pickup particle bursts. Strengthen the upgrade menu freeze logic to fully disable player damage and loss of controls, regardless of enemy spawning or input latency during selection mode. Thoroughly test all augmented mechanics to confirm no regressions in existing auto-firing, HUD, controls, pause/resume, or upgrade selection flow. Maintain compatibility with one-finger mobile controls and preserve existing stable URL and baseline gameplay contract.
required_evidence: Gameplay recordings demonstrating player health restoration and maxHp increases at levels 3, 6, and 9.
Logs or observable gameplay showing distinct new enemy variants spawning and exhibiting unique movement/attack behaviors from player level 3 onward.
UI screenshots or accessibility audits confirming that milestone upgrade menus display special abilities with clear labels and concise descriptions on various mobile viewports.
Visual and audio capture verifying fish collectible pickups produce enhanced lingering animations and sound cues persisting briefly after acquisition.
Gameplay test logs confirming upgrade selection screens fully freeze game time and combat, granting invulnerability and no loss of player control even during enemy spawns or input lag.

Regression test results showing all pre-existing game systems such as automatic firing, HUD display (HP/max HP), controls, pause/resume/restart mechanisms, and upgrade menu operations function smoothly post-implementation.
Balance analysis or QA reports verifying smooth difficulty scaling with new enemy types and milestone upgrades without unfair difficulty spikes.

critic.claim: The current plan adequately focuses on milestone health restoration, new enemy variants, milestone upgrade options, enhanced fish pickup feedback, and upgrade menu freeze, but leaves substantial uncertainty around failure modes such as unresponsive start, fake progress, touch input edge cases, pause/restart robustness, viewport overflow, balance risks, and incomplete mobile accessibility of prompts.
critic.rationale: The supplied evidence reveals a well-structured update approach to add health gain on milestone level-ups, diverse enemies starting level 3, special milestone upgrades with UI labeling, persistent fish pickup feedback, and frozen, damage-immune upgrade screens. The game.js source and index.html confirm controls including pointer and fallback touch handlers, pause, restart, and upgrade mechanics with freezing. The QA report documents passing desktop Chromium mobile-emulated acceptance. However, detailed handling and testing of failure cases like unresponsive start (button disabled or script/cache mismatch), fake progress simulation, pointer cancel and lostpointercapture edge cases on touch, pause/resume/restart race conditions, viewport overflow and camera clamp boundaries, upgrade balance guaranteeing no runaway exploits, and explicit accessibility of milestone upgrade labels on small mobile devices are not proven or fully traced in the source or QA. The source mentions fallback touch handlers for Samsung Android, but physical device testing remains unverified. The upgrade freeze disables damage and input loss logically but no explicit race condition testing or exploit hardening is shown. UI labeling and responsiveness claims exist but screenshots and mobile accessibility audits are awaited.
objections: The initialization script handles boot/version mismatch by disabling start with visible messaging, but no explicit test for persistent unresponsive start due to other errors or latency/fake progress is described.
Touch input fallback only covers Samsung Android with workaround but lacks broader mobile or unusual touchscreen device coverage.
Pause and restart clear inputs and reset game state, but concurrency hazards like pause during upgrade freeze or restart race conditions are not explicitly handled or evidenced.
Viewport clamping prevents renderer overflow but edge cases with camera translation shake offsets and large map boundaries need verification on very small or zoomed mobile screens.
Balance failure modes are assumed addressed by milestone caps and cooldown limits, but no detailed metrics or QA logs on exploit prevention or fairness curves were provided.
Fish pickup feedback uses lingering animations but relies on particles and transient sound generation without tested fallback for muted/reduced-motion or performance limits under rapid collection.
Upgrade menu freeze disables player damage via game.mode checks and input clearing but lacks explicit mitigation for network lag or hostile input injection.
Accessibility and clarity of milestone upgrade UI labeling for small mobile form factors are stated but no audit or screenshot evidence confirming no overflow or truncation is shown.
No evidence rules out fake time or score injection during level-up or upgrade screens, nor verifies integrity of CATACLYSM_DIAGNOSTICS snapshot data against manipulated states.
required_evidence: Automated and manual test results covering unresponsive start failure modes on various devices and networks, showing user-visible diagnostic messages and recovery options.

Touch input and pointer event trace logs on multiple real mobile devices (Android variants beyond Samsung, iOS Safari) demonstrating correct input acquisition, pointercancel, and lostpointercapture behavior.
Pause/resume/restart concurrency tests, ideally automated, proving no input loss, hung states, or game state corruption during rapid or overlapping state changes.
Viewport render tests and recorded screen captures from the smallest supported mobile devices verifying no camera or UI overflow, all HUD and upgrade menu text visible and properly scaled.

Balance report with instrumental gameplay logs or simulation data demonstrating milestone upgrade impact on difficulty, capped firing cooldown preventing exploit, and health gain integration preserving challenge.
Audio/visual recording or screen captures showing extended lingering fish pickup animations and sounds, including behavior with reduced motion enabled and on muted devices.
Unit/integration test logs or video demonstrating upgrade menu freeze guaranteeing player damage immunity and no control loss even during enemy spawn or lag spikes.
Mobile accessibility audit report or screenshots confirming milestone upgrade option UI clarity, touch target size, label readability, and no clipping on various mobile resolutions.
Integrity audit of CATACLYSM_DIAGNOSTICS.snapshot() data verifying correctness and no artificial progress injection during paused, upgrade, or other game states.

engineer.claim: Implement the Cataclysm update to add milestone level health restoration with maxHp increase, new enemy variants from level 3, milestone-specific special upgrades with clear mobile UI, enhanced fish pickup persistent feedback, and comprehensive upgrade menu freeze disabling damage and input loss while preserving all existing mechanics and controls.
engineer.rationale: Existing game code already supports level-based upgrades and game state freezing during upgrade menus, automatic firing, fish collectibles, and health UI. However, it lacks explicit logic for maxHp/health increment on level-up milestones, unique enemy variants with distinct behaviors starting at level 3, milestone-level upgrade options including special abilities, improved fish pickup feedback with lingering animation and looping audio, and complete player invulnerability and input lockout during upgrade menu interaction. Implementing these features maintains and builds on the stable core loop and interface, enhances player progression satisfaction, gameplay variety, and mobile UI clarity. Freezing the simulation and clearing inputs during upgrade selection will be strengthened explicitly to prevent any damage or control loss even with enemy spawn events or input latency. Upgrades and maxHp caps will prevent runaway exploits. The enhancements will be tested for regressions in auto-fire, HUD, controls, pause/resume, restart, and upgrade menu smoothness, preserving mobile compatibility.
engineer.objections: No direct evidence exists that current code implements the milestone maxHp and health restoration or new enemy variants with unique behaviors. Fish pickup feedback is limited to ephemeral particle bursts and sound without lingering effects. Upgrade menu freeze currently disables game running but does not explicitly block damage or input disruptions that could occur with spawn timing and input lag. Mobile accessibility audits and screenshots for milestone upgrade UI clarity and labeled special abilities are unavailable, leaving uncertainty about usability on small screens. Physical-device Samsung Android input issues and real mobile browser touch acceptance tests remain incomplete. The upgrade balance and difficulty scaling need detailed verification to avoid making the game too easy or exploit-prone. The CATACLYSM_DIAGNOSTICS snapshot data integrity against fake progress injection during upgrades and pauses is not validated. These gaps necessitate focused implementation and extensive functional and acceptance testing.

proposed_action.1: Modify player level-up logic to increase maxHp by 1 up to 9 and restore current health on levels 3, 6, and 9.
proposed_action.2: Extend enemy spawn logic to introduce a new enemy variant starting at player level 3 with distinct size, speed, and a simple unique movement or attack pattern.
proposed_action.3: Enhance the upgrade overlay UI to append milestone-specific special upgrades such as multi-shot and bouncing bullets with clear labeled buttons and concise mobile-friendly descriptions.
proposed_action.4: Augment fish collectible pickup logic to trigger an additional visible lingering animation (e.g., lingering glow or pulse) and a looping audio cue that fades out rather than immediate sound burst, respecting reduced motion and mute states.
proposed_action.5: Strengthen upgrade menu state freeze to explicitly set player invulnerability and fully disable input acceptance that affects movement or damage handling; test against enemy spawn timing and input lag to guarantee no damage or control loss during upgrade selection.
proposed_action.6: Verify all pre-existing mechanics: smooth auto-fire, correct health and max HP display in HUD, keyboard and pointer controls, pause/resume/restart flows, and stable URL remain intact.
proposed_action.7: Add logging or visual indicators to demonstrate new enemy variant appearance and behavior from level 3 and milestone upgrades showing special ability options.
proposed_action.8: Conduct functional tests to confirm difficulty scales smoothly without unfair spikes or trivialization from health gain or new abilities.

proposed_action.10: Preserve the existing CATACLYSM_DIAGNOSTICS.snapshot() structure, enhancing it to include milestone upgrade flags and new enemy variant counts without fabricating or falsifying game state.

required_evidence: Gameplay recordings showing player's maxHp increases and current HP restoration at milestone levels 3, 6, and 9 with visible HUD updates.
Video or log evidence displaying spawning and distinct behavior of the new enemy variant appearing at player level 3+.

Screenshots and accessibility audit results confirming milestone upgrade menus display special abilities (multi-shot, bouncing bullets) with clear labels and descriptions on multiple mobile device resolutions.
Visual and audio captures evidencing fish collectible pickups trigger lingering animations and persistent audio cues that respect mute and reduced motion user settings.

Gameplay testing logs and demonstrations verifying upgrade selection freezes all game time and combat, player is invulnerable, no damage or control loss can occur despite enemy spawn or input lag during upgrades.
Regression testing ensuring auto-fire, HUD clarity, keyboard and pointer controls, pause/resume/restart functionality, and upgrade menu operations continue to operate smoothly post-update.
Balance validation data or QA reports showing difficulty scaling with new enemy types and milestone upgrades remains fair and challenging without exploit paths or abrupt difficulty changes.
Mobile device test logs or screenshots verifying that all new UI elements including milestone upgrades are rendered clearly and accessible, with no overlapping or truncated text on small screens.
Integrity checks on CATACLYSM_DIAGNOSTICS.snapshot() confirming no artificial progression, time, or score injection during paused or upgrade states.

qa.claim: The updated Cataclysm survival playtest meets the pre-publication preview criteria for a playable isolated preview implementing the prompt.
qa.rationale: The source code shows implemented mechanics for health restoration with an increased max HP cap at milestones, introduction of two distinct enemy variants (weaver and dasher) starting at level 3 with unique behaviors, additional special upgrades at milestone levels (multi-shot, ricochet, fish magnet), and fish collectibles that produce a lingering visual effect and sound upon pickup. The gameplay state freezes fully during upgrade selection, preventing damage and input loss as verified by the logic clearing inputs and setting player invulnerability. Independent browser tests with mobile emulation on two viewports report passing essential interaction checks (touch start, advancing game time, player movement, pause and resume functionality, restart, HUD updates, no failed resources) with significant player displacement indicating active gameplay. The HUD includes clear labels for HP/max health, fish collected, kills, and level progression, along with a modal upgrade menu showing special upgrades at milestone levels with descriptive labels compatible with mobile display. Auto-fire cat and controls appear preserved with no regression signals in functional or UI behavior. No errors or asset failures were recorded in the browser tests. While physical device testing and audio capture were not performed, the prompt and acceptance criteria do not require these for preview approval. The coder report also confirms automated VM test harness verification of key gameplay logic related to upgrades, health restoration at milestones, and enemy variant behavior, strengthening evidence that changes are active and integrated. The upgrade selection overlay disables enemy spawning and damage, aligning with the requirement that players cannot lose control or health during upgrade interactions.
qa.objections: There is no direct browser screenshot or video recording to visually confirm the upgrade menu interface and special upgrade indication on mobile. The long-run survival balance is unverified, and reaching level 9 unaided remains to be tested. Audio behavior is inferred from code but not audibly confirmed due to lack of capture. Physical device testing was not performed. No independent QA human evaluation of player enjoyment or difficulty smoothness was submitted. Although browser emulation passed, emulated input fidelity may differ from real devices. The difficulty curve's fairness with new enemies and enhancements is assumed based on preserved parameters but not thoroughly demonstrated by long-duration test runs.

proposed_action.reason: All primary gameplay and interface features requested by the prompt are present and active in the isolated preview code and confirmed by executed independent browser tests. Gameplay is observable and controllable, with upgrades, new enemies, and health progression functioning as intended. Freeze during upgrade selection and prevention of damage are implemented. Remaining concerns primarily relate to post-publication verification steps, not preview gates.

Browser screenshots or video recordings demonstrating the special upgrade menu on milestone levels on a variety of mobile devices.

coder_report:
# Cataclysm update report

Implemented in `docs/preview/index.html`, `game.js`, and `game.css`; stable target URL and existing control/diagnostic interfaces preserved. Read job.json, plan.json and feedback.md (empty feedback array); no prior gate.log was present.

## Changes against request criteria

- Every third level (3, 6, 9 and onward) automatically adds one maximum heart, capped at 9, and fully restores health. Thus levels 3/6/9 provide 4/5/6 maximum HP, reaching 9 at level 18. The milestone menu explains the reward.
- Starting at level 3, regular spawn slots alternate in purple weaving enemies and orange dashers. Weavers approach with lateral oscillation; dashers visibly wind up before short committed bursts. Existing shamblers and later heavy enemies remain. Spawn cadence, overall enemy cap, baseline HP and time-based difficulty ramp are preserved; dashers trade slow recovery for speed bursts.
- Milestone menus retain firing rate, damage and movement upgrades and add multi-shot (up to five shots), bouncing bullets that seek fresh targets (up to three bounces), and Cat's Catch fish attraction (three boosts). All have descriptive mobile buttons; the modal scrolls when necessary. Health is automatic so selecting an ability does not sacrifice recovery.
- Collected fish leave a fading gold ring and +1 FISH label for 0.9 simulation seconds and play a 0.28-second fading synthesized tone. Effects are capped at 24. Reduced motion retains the stationary fading label/ring and suppresses existing particle bursts. Existing mute behavior is honored; audio remains optional if unsupported.
- Upgrade selection stops tick progression, blocks spawns and damage explicitly, clears held inputs, rejects movement key acquisition during selection, and clears inputs again on selection. Resume grants one second of protection, allowing a fresh drag/key press without immediate contact damage. Pause remains unavailable during the already-frozen upgrade state, as before.
- Auto-targeting/fire, touch joystick, keyboard movement, cancellation/release handlers, pause/resume, restart, HUD, saved best score, no-store config loading and read-only diagnostics remain. Diagnostics additionally expose real enemy variants, pickup effects and ability stats. Build handshake and local asset query versions were updated together.

## Commands and outcomes

- `node --check docs/preview/game.js` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- `node /tmp/cataclysm-check.cjs` — passed using a temporary Node VM harness with mocked browser UI/audio and the actual game functions. Verified health restoration at milestones and the nine-heart cap; identical diagnostic snapshots across frozen ticks and attempted spawns; resume protection; ability caps and selection; both enemy variants; five-shot firing; pickup persistence/expiry; and clean restart resets. Harness instrumentation was temporary and is not part of shipped game code or diagnostics.
- `node game_factory/mobile_acceptance.cjs` — attempted; Chrome failed before page load with `setsockopt: Operation not permitted` and SIGTRAP. No browser acceptance pass is claimed.

## Limitations

No gameplay recording, audio capture, browser screenshots, physical-phone verification, independent QA approval or deployment was completed. The VM checks verify game logic, not rendered layout, real touch responsiveness or audible output. Milestone menu sizing and reduced-motion behavior were reviewed in source but need browser confirmation. Difficulty retains the prior progression curve and limits new variants to half of spawn slots; long-run survival balance and reaching level 9 through unassisted play remain unverified.
